messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

You can now enter a **Deal name** before exporting a snapshot. Loading that snapshot restores the name and progress; clearing the name keeps exports in the existing version 1 format.

I also fixed snapshot imports so valid JSON properties can appear in any order. Invalid snapshots still leave the current game unchanged.

Verification passed: 143 unit tests and all 78 browser tests, including the new save-and-load journey.
